title: indigo_ccd_ptp: recorded non-interactive simulator test run after the EOS R6 Mark II exposure fix
description: Non-interactive simulator run of the indigo_ccd_ptp hardware-free tests on driver version 3.0.0.63 (after ticket 32c9bae5, commit cbfe9d17a), made with 'python3 tools/run_driver_test.py ccd_ptp'. The script records the run in indigo_drivers/ccd_ptp/README.md '## Testing' and regenerates TEST_SUMMARY.md; both are committed with the ticket. Fix every defect found, rerun the full scope, do not push. Hardware coverage is not part of this run.

outcome.summary: Diff vs master (merge base 5782cf7d1) touches only indigo_drivers/ccd_ptp/README.md:65 and TEST_SUMMARY.md:192. README line '- 2026-11-20 20:09 3.0.0.63 mac arm64 fake SDK 184/184 OK' follows the indigo_test/AGENTS.md record format; 3.0.0.63 matches DRIVER_VERSION 0x0300003F (indigo_ptp.h:36). It correctly replaces the previous 'mac arm64 fake SDK' line (same os/arch/type, version not part of match); HW lines untouched and order stays by timestamp. Count 184 = 177 cases in test_ccd_ptp_sdk.c tests[] + 7 in test_ccd_ptp_ica.m (the ica source is .m, not .c); the script selects exactly test_ccd_ptp_sdk and test_ccd_ptp_ica. Delta vs previous 180 (173+7 at a00e5ab4f) is explained by +3 reply_bounds cases and canon_mirror_unknown_value split into two unreported cases. MIGRATION_STATUS.md already shows 184 / 16. tools/make_test_summary.py -o <scratch> output is byte-identical to the branch TEST_SUMMARY.md. Timestamp matches the journal (run started 19:09Z = 20:09 +0100). master has not touched TEST_SUMMARY.md or ccd_ptp since the merge base. Not verified: did not rebuild or rerun the suite; pass/fail result taken from the record and journal.
